name: Neighborhood Mover
service_area: Ocala, Marion County and Silver Springs, FL
address_note: No safe public street address to publish: this is a small family-run operation and the addresses found associated with the listing are residential-type. Per pipeline rule (variante adaptada), we do NOT publish any home address. contacto section uses a real photo (contacto.imagen) instead of an embedded map; no 'mapa' key in content.json.
social_note: This business has ONLY a Facebook page, no Instagram. Per derive.py, top-level ig_url/ig_handle are reused for the footer social link / CTA-final follow button / social_proof default link, but relabeled honestly via content.json's optional social_label ('Facebook') and social_cta keys so the page never claims a Facebook link is Instagram.
website_investigation: Verified carefully during this session: the domain theneighborhoodmover.com resolves and returns a live page, but WebFetch confirmed it is an UNRELATED third-party lead-generation/appliance-repair site with different phone numbers and an explicit on-page disclaimer stating 'this domain is actively listed for sale'. It is NOT this business's website, just a coincidental domain-name match. No other plausible domain guess resolved. Google Maps shows no website button on this business's listing (only call/directions). Recording this explicitly so no future session mistakes theneighborhoodmover.com for Neighborhood Mover's own site.
rating_source: Google Maps listing, verified live during this session
fleet_note: Small family-run mover. Photos show them renting U-Haul box trucks rather than owning a branded fleet. Do NOT claim 'our fleet of trucks': copy is phrased honestly as bringing the truck and the crew to the job.
services_offered: Local residential moves (Ocala / Marion County / Silver Springs)
Careful handling of furniture (wrapping/protecting large or fragile pieces, visible in real photos)
pricing: No public pricing exists anywhere researched. Not invented. servicios cards omit 'precio'; servicios.nota tells the visitor every move is quoted by phone.
reviews_verbatim: None available/verifiable (no quoted, attributed Google reviews found). social_proof.modo = 'razones' with 3 honest reason cards; the 4.7/163 rating is used as numeric trust data in hero.rating and one strip item, but no fabricated testimonial quotes are used anywhere.
language_note: No signal customers are primarily Spanish-speaking (English-language market, Ocala FL). Site defaults to English but is fully bilingual EN/ES per pipeline requirement (mandatory toggle, real Spanish translations for every text field).
sources: Google Maps business listing (rating 4.7, 163 reviews, phone (352) 480-0804, category moving company, 20 business photos) - verified live during this session
Web search for public contact email (Neighborhoodmover1@gmail.com)
curl/WebFetch attempt on theneighborhoodmover.com confirming it is an unrelated third-party site for sale, not this business
photo_format_note: gmaps-8.jpg and gmaps-20.jpg were downloaded with a .jpg extension but actually decoded as PNG. Both are valid, real photos from the Google Maps listing. gmaps-20.jpg (used in the final gallery) was re-encoded to a real baseline JPEG during the performance resize pass below; all other originals are untouched except the ones used in the build, which were resized/re-encoded for performance.
